title: A failed board re-read, such as a 403 after a stream end, left the task detail's snapshot shown without its lost notice
resolution: A failed board of the detail's project drops the detail and shows why, with the role a 403 names and a retry of the board and the detail.

title: A resync after a restore could replace the board below the detail's position, and the detail then never read again
resolution: The board feed numbers its snapshots, and the detail reads again for each new one whatever the positions, also without the card.

title: The always-open Drawer unmounted with its route, so Mantine's focus return never ran and closing it lost the focus
resolution: The route focuses again, when it leaves, the element focused as it opened, else the board's heading.

title: The header's project picker sat behind the modal Drawer, so choosing another project while the detail was open was out of reach
resolution: The Drawer shows the Mantine project picker at its top, and the tests use it by pointer and keyboard without hidden elements.

title: Identifiers with a dot or a slash gave task detail addresses that the SPA's server answers with 404
resolution: Each character other than a letter, a digit, a hyphen, or an underscore is written as a tilde and two hex digits, and read back before any read.

title: Gate identifiers in badges, unbroken identifiers, and four-column tables could force sideways scrolling at phone width
resolution: Stages and trace links are bordered lists, gate identifiers stand beside their badges, and every run without a space may break every 16 characters.

title: A Mantine Title inside the Drawer's own h2 nested two headings
resolution: The Drawer's title is plain text in Mantine's own h2, with a test of one level 2 heading.

title: The design said the detail reads only once its board shows, and took a missing card-changed for a supported limitation
resolution: Decision 7 states the independent first read, and the risks call a missing card-changed a violation of wire contracts sections 8 and 10.

title: The evidence check left the prompt's rerun mention unresolved, task 3.2 open, and pass 2 required without the stop rule
resolution: The evidence check states the one passing run and no rerun, task 3.2 is ticked, and the remaining gates follow the stop rule.

title: A board feed restarted without the detail feed could repeat or skip a snapshot number that the hook still held
resolution: Each new detail feed forgets the snapshot and the card it saw, so a retry of both after a resync reads the detail once.

title: Risk 2 named only a change of another card as the cause of the second detail read on a direct open
resolution: Risk 2 now states the concurrent reads of a direct open and why an equal card does not skip the read: a change of the detail alone can leave the card unchanged.

title: Paper and Text blocks sat inside the span of Mantine's List.Item, which is invalid HTML
resolution: The lists are Mantine Stack ol or ul elements (ItemList) of Paper or Text li items, Mantine only.

title: Each section's aria-label repeated the text of its own h3
resolution: Each section is named by its h3 through aria-labelledby.

title: Closing the Drawer pushed the board, so Back after a card link opened the detail again
resolution: A card link marks its entry with the page load; closing such a detail goes back, and any other entry, a direct link or a reload, is replaced by the board.

title: The scenario Another project on another page had no test
resolution: A test chooses another project in the header's picker on /app/sessions and expects the page to stay; it fails with the picker always leading to the board.

title: identifierOf decoded only uppercase hexadecimal escapes, so a hand-edited lowercase address named another identifier
resolution: Coordinator rule: lowercase only if the control plane also decodes it; web-app.ts buildPath (lines 70-79) decodes only percent-encoding and knows no ~ form, and taskDetailPath writes uppercase, so the SPA stays strict and one task keeps one address.

title: The detail views imported stepOf and ObstacleText from the card view, a view-to-view dependency
resolution: stepOf moved to board-labels.ts and ObstacleText to its own module, which the card and the detail both import.
